newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis to discuss EMU with Spain's Rato Monday.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis to discuss EMU with Spain's Rato Monday.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday he planned to discuss European monetary union and other international issues at a meeting in Madrid on Monday with Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato.
The meeting is part of a twice-yearly series of bilateral talks between the Spanish and French finance ministers.
Arthuis told a news conference he would discuss the follow-up to a European Union summit in Dublin in December which laid the groundwork for the practical running of monetary union.

He would also discuss the forthcoming ministerial meeting of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) in Paris in May and Group of Seven rich nations meeting in Washington in April.
He declined further comment on progress to European monetary union, which Spain is determined to join when it is first launched in January 1999.
The Madrid talks start at 1030 GMT and end with a news conference at 1145 GMT.
